fact: The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority's page describes SUDAPASS as the national digital identity platform providing secure identity verification with multi-factor authentication (biometrics, PIN code, QR code).

The terms govern the Sudanese Digital Identity smartphone application and platform, whose digital signatures, issued under a certified digital identity, are legally equal to handwritten ones under Article 8 of the 2007 Electronic Transactions Act.
Digital identity is issued through certifiers licensed by the National Electronic Authentication Authority and gives access to governmental and commercial services.
The Sudanese Digital Identity application for smartphones lets a user hold an account and sign electronic transactions that are valid and binding with evidential power before courts.
